sentences.text:
The instant criminal petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C)/under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') has been filed by the petitioner/accused No.2, seeking quashment of the proceedings pending against him in FIR.No.21/2020 on the file of Nandyal II Town P.S., for the offences under Section 420, 468, 120(b)
r/w 34 IPC.
2.

When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that charge sheet is filed in this matter and the petition may be disposed of giving liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition.
3. Mrs.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor on behalf of the State is in attendance.
5. In that view of the matter, this Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to file a fresh petition, if so advised.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

Dr. JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA Date: 05.01.2026.
